seams.summary: Cold War's Penguin Agility Course water leg cannot be driven: (a) ENGINE: src/torirsserver/torirs_server_scene.c terrain_is_ocean() counts overlay 537 (the course's wading water, 2628-2635,4053-4065,0) as ocean and ocean_blocks_walk blocks it, so a player cannot walk one tile there and stepstone01 refuses 'I can't reach that!'; (b) CONTENT: nothing takes the player from the guide's start tile 2636,4054,1 down into the level-0 water (Quest Helper agilityEnterWater -> inAgilityWater); (c) CONTENT: the crusher npcs peng_agility_crushcourse_crushblock01..04_npc have no op, and the wiki says they are passed by timing a walk. Make the water walkable without opening real ocean anywhere else (an overlay exception or a per-area walk rule, proven not to change a sailing or coastal test), give the course its documented entry into the water, and drive the guide's agilityEnterWater .. agilityExitWater steps through the real client.
seams.evidence: test/quests/wip/coldwar/leg4.json (blocked at agilityExitWater: course water leg unwalkable), build/seam_state/vm-b1-seam1/fix.driver_other_floor_loc.json open_issues (overlay 537, ocean_blocks_walk, crushers without ops, stone 7). Source: wiki Penguin Agility Course and Cold War quick guide; docs/quests/cold_war.md; ladder.py coldwar --leg 4.
